preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 100 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of elements in the list a is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= a_i <= 50 for a_i in map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2])
preconditions.description: For each test case, each element a_i in the list a is between 0 and 50.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 100.

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) == sum(int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]) + len(stdin.splitlines()[1::2])
postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the sum of n over all test cases plus the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s_i) <= 200 for s_i in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each string s_i in the output has a length between 1 and 200.

postconditions.expression: all(all(s_i[:a_i] == s_j[:a_i] for a_i, s_i, s_j in zip(map(int, lines[1].split()), lines[2+i].split(), lines[3+i].split())) for i, lines in enumerate(zip(stdin.splitlines()[1::2], stdin.splitlines()[2::2], output_lines[::2], output_lines[1::2])))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the longest common prefix of strings s_i and s_{i+1} is equal to a_i.
